RANGE¶

Extracts raw PCM data interleaved by channel for the given stream id and range.

Arguments¶

Name

Type

Description

stream_id

string

ASCII ID of the audio stream.

start

float

Start time (in seconds) to extract from the stream.

duration

float

Duration of audio segment to extract (in seconds).

Input¶

Type

Description

null

N/A

Output¶

Type

Description

s32v

PCM buffer containing samples interleaved by channel. Both 16-bit and 24-bit samples are stored in s32v.

Example¶

RANGE 'vocals' 0.0 30.0
